definitions.hook: A v4 hook's permissions are the low 14 bits of its address. It can return swap deltas if BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA (bit 3) or AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA (bit 2) is set. review.question: Is proposal {proposalId}, the framework diff with keccak256 {diffHash} from core@{base} to core@{next}, beneficial to the framework under every criterion in the definitions?

definitions.diff: The diff is the file at {diffUrl}, a commit URL in github.com/zhongeric/tvf-core. Its keccak256 must equal {diffHash}.
definitions.accuracy: Accuracy: core@{next} improves or keeps detection on the backtest corpus compared with core@{base}.
definitions.regression: Regression: no check flips a result that was previously attested and confirmed correct on the backtest set.
definitions.gaming: Gaming: no wording, threshold or source change makes a known-risky token pass, and no change favours a specific token, deployer or source.
definitions.schema: Schema: core@{next} validates against tvf-1, every check stays bool, and the semver bump is correct (patch for wording or definitions, minor to add a check or change a default threshold, major to remove a check or change scoring).
definitions.scope: Scope: the diff does not modify review or scoring.weights.
definitions.evidence: Evidence: the backtest report at {reportUrl} is reproducible.
definitions.default: If any criterion is unproven, answer false.
